correctness.rationale: The cyclic inverse recurrence fixes normalization. The exact pair-product Rademacher variance gives a weighted circulant Ising energy. All squared Green weights have strictly positive circular second differences. An exact telescope decomposes the energy into a positive combination of window-square energies, each bounded below for odd binary rings and simultaneously saturated by one-defect alternating signs. Positive two-window weight forces exactly one monochromatic bond, proving uniqueness and count; exact distance pair counts give the finite variance. Absolutely convergent geometric sums give the finite-size parity term and comparison ratios. The embedded standard-library checker passed 502,920 exact-rational assertions over n=5,7,9,11,13,15 and three rational screening parameters; finite enumeration is corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural fixed two-linear-solve stochastic trace-estimation design problem on odd periodic grids has no proper two-coloring, and the even-grid Fourier argument does not apply. The theorem rigorously resolves every partition at all positive shifts, counts every optimum, computes exact variance, and isolates a nonzero O(1) finite-size parity-frustration cost. This is a structural and operationally interpretable answer, not a known general estimator identity or an arbitrarily selected finite example. Its sensitivity to restricted probe architecture is explicitly stated.
